text: AI-Based Data Governance: Empowering Trust and Compliance in Complex Data Ecosystems presents the following source proposition: Leveraging machine learning and natural language processing, the system can adapt to evolving regulatory requirements, perform real-time data classification, and recommend corrective actions.
